user.title: Connect to EkkoAir VMC
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant reaches the Modbus interface.

tcp.title: Modbus TCP gateway
tcp.description: Enter the actual Modbus TCP host and port. The Node-RED editor port is not the Modbus port.

serial.title: RS-485 / Modbus RTU
serial.description: For a transparent serial server, enter socket://HOST:PORT as the device. The manual default is 19200 baud, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the VMC registers. Check the connection, unit ID, and Modbus settings.

abort.already_configured: This Modbus endpoint and unit ID are already configured.
